node.label: Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA)
node.summary: Implementation of the CAA, 2019 granting citizenship to persecuted minorities from Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan.

facts.text: West Bengal's government said it aims to grant citizenship under the **CAA** to **2.5 lakh Matuas** (Hindu Namasudras with roots in Bangladesh) by 31 December 2026; only 25,000 have received citizenship under the CAA so far.
